author: cellish
body:
Hi there!
I made a new map and this time its not a DTM just because of that 1. when i make DTM's they're so similiar to each other lol, and also i just felt for making a map with another gamemode. Anyways, its a little bit different this time, I atold my friends to pick 9 blocks that didn't have to fit with each other or so, but that are good to build with, although i used more than 9 blocks, but later on when i began to come a little bit into the map i just felt for adding some blocks and it turned into a CHRISTMAS MAP!!!
Anyways, hope you like it! <3 ;)

XML/YML idk wat lel: COMING SOON
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/eu19xh1dnc1b50b/Sam12.rar
Images: http://imgur.com/a/oOoaj
Teams: Red Elves vs Green Elves
Kill Rewards: 4 arrows. you also earn 1 gapple after 2 kills (not if you die between the kills)

Btw, if the map doesn't fit with blocks (wood and that you can place blocks) just remove the blocks and edit the map so there's no iron (iron is in the spawning house)

replies.author: Myv
replies.body:
It is a bit square with a plain block palette.

It looks festive which is your aim but the lanes are too thin and like ryan said, one team may be able to trap the others by bowspamming if they are superior due to the paths.

But it's a work in progress for sure, and it looks promising.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
We regret to inform you that your map will not be added. We have declined it for the following reasons:

- Needs better placement of structures.
- Needs more interesting pathways to make gameplay more enjoyable rather than just looping the same process.
- Too basic, straight paths are not good for gameplay and especially these, a team could defend 3 paths and not have to worry about anything.
- Poor block pallet and layout.

If changes are made, you may repost your map with the requests above, and reply to this comment. We will then reevaluate it for further action on whether or not it will be accepted.

Thank you very much for submitting!
